title_en: Notice of Pilot Operation of the Graduation and Completion Status Check Program
summary: The Academic Affairs Office has developed a program for checking graduation and completion status, planned for formal operation in the second semester of 2026 (during September). A pilot operation begins on 10 August 2026 at 13:00 so that the service can be improved before formal operation.
applies_to: Undergraduate and graduate students. The notice is issued for reference and does not state that any action is mandatory.

dates.what: Start of the pilot operation of the program
Planned formal operation of the program

steps: Undergraduate students: open the program via Student Services > Graduation > Graduation Application > Undergraduate Graduation Application and Status [학생서비스 > 졸업 > 졸업신청 > 학부졸업신청 및 현황].
Graduate students: open the program via Student Services > Graduation > Thesis-related > Thesis/Achievement Review Application and Completion Status [학생서비스 > 졸업 > 논문관련 > 논문/실적심사 신청 및 수료현황].
Check the progress status and results of graduation, completion and thesis/achievement review for your major.
translation:
Notice of Pilot Operation of the Graduation and Completion Status Check Program

Posted: 10 August 2026

To make it more convenient and accessible for students to manage their graduation and completion schedules, the Academic Affairs Office [학사과] has developed a Graduation and Completion Status Check Program and plans to begin formal operation in the second semester of 2026 (during September).

Accordingly, before formal operation, a pilot operation will be carried out as follows in order to improve the service. Please refer to the details below.

A. Program start date and time: Monday, 10 August 2026, 13:00

B. Graduation and Completion Status Check Program
- (Undergraduate) Student Services > Graduation > Graduation Application > Undergraduate Graduation Application and Status [학생서비스 > 졸업 > 졸업신청 > 학부졸업신청 및 현황]
- (Graduate) Student Services > Graduation > Thesis-related > Thesis/Achievement Review Application and Completion Status [학생서비스 > 졸업 > 논문관련 > 논문/실적심사 신청 및 수료현황]

C. Items to check
- Progress status and results of graduation, completion and thesis/achievement review by major
- Diploma (degree certificate) [학위기(졸업증서)] information

Attachments (2)
- (Attachment 1) Undergraduate screen [학부생 화면.png] (244 KB)
- (Attachment 2) Graduate student screen [대학원생 화면.png] (367 KB)

Note: The attachments are image files whose content is not included in the text of the notice; they were not read for this translation.
